records.headline: India's Foreign Exchange Reserves Touch Record High Surpassing $700 Billion Mark
records.summary: The Reserve Bank of India reported that India's foreign exchange reserves surged to a historic high, crossing the $700 billion milestone driven by strong foreign portfolio investment inflows, robust valuation gains in gold reserves, and sustained trade remittances.
records.exam_fact: India became only the fourth country in the world (after China, Japan, and Switzerland) to cross $700 Billion in foreign currency reserves.
records.why_important: Adequate forex reserves shield the domestic currency from abrupt speculative depreciation and provide an import cover of over 11 months.
records.related_static_topic: Balance of Payments (BoP) & Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA 1999)
records.related_banking_topic: Custody of Forex by RBI (Section 40 of RBI Act, 1934)

mcqs.question: Which institution in India acts as the sole custodian of the country's foreign exchange reserves?
mcqs.explanation: Under Section 40 of the RBI Act 1934 and provisions of FEMA 1999, the Reserve Bank of India is the custodian and manager of India's foreign exchange reserves.

records.source: Reserve Bank of India Weekly Statistical Supplement (rbi.org.in)

records.headline: ISRO Announces Launch Schedule for Shukrayaan-1 Venus Orbiter Mission
records.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) formalized mission configurations for 'Shukrayaan-1', India's first scientific mission to explore Venus, slated to investigate surface geology and the thick atmospheric chemistry of the planet.
records.exam_fact: Shukrayaan-1 will be launched using ISRO's LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-3) heavy-lift rocket.
records.why_important: Marks India's third planetary exploration milestone following Chandrayaan (Moon) and Mangalyaan (Mars).
records.related_banking_topic: Commercial space funding and IN-SPACe initiatives

mcqs.question: Which rocket is designated to launch ISRO's Venus exploration orbiter Shukrayaan-1?
mcqs.explanation: ISRO has earmarked its heaviest operational launch vehicle, LVM3 (Launch Vehicle Mark-3), for the interplanetary Shukrayaan-1 mission.

records.source: ISRO Press Briefing / Department of Space (isro.gov.in)

records.headline: Government Appoints New Executive Director at International Monetary Fund (IMF) Representing India
records.summary: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (ACC) approved the appointment of a senior financial economist as Executive Director (India) at the International Monetary Fund (IMF) headquarters in Washington D.C., representing the constituency of India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka.
records.exam_fact: India represents a four-country constituency at the IMF Executive Board comprising India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka.
records.why_important: IMF voting rights and quota revisions directly influence global sovereign funding and SDR allocations.
records.related_banking_topic: Special Drawing Rights (SDR) and Forex Reserves

mcqs.question: Which of the following countries is NOT part of India's voting constituency at the IMF Executive Board?
mcqs.explanation: India represents India, Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka at the IMF Executive Board. Nepal is represented in a different constituency.

records.source: Appointments Committee of the Cabinet (DoPT pib.gov.in)

records.headline: PMAY-U 2.0 Cabinet Approval: 1 Crore Additional Affordable Houses for Urban Poor
records.summary: Union Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister approved Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) with an investment of ₹10 Lakh Crore, offering interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹35 Lakh for EWS/LIG families.
records.exam_fact: Under PMAY-U 2.0, the Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) provides an upfront 4.0% interest subsidy on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for tenures up to 12 years.
records.why_important: Massive driver for priority sector housing credit and affordable housing construction across Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities.
records.related_static_topic: Fundamental Right to Shelter (Article 21) & Urbanisation in India
records.related_banking_topic: Priority Sector Lending (PSL) Housing Credit Caps

mcqs.question: Under PMAY-U 2.0 Interest Subsidy Scheme, what is the maximum interest subvention percentage provided on eligible home loans?
mcqs.explanation: PMAY-U 2.0 provides an interest subsidy of 4.0% per annum on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for a maximum loan tenure of 12 years.

records.headline: India Adds 3 New Wetlands to Ramsar Convention Network Taking Total to 85 Sites
records.summary: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change announced that 3 more wetlands from India have been designated as Wetlands of International Importance under the Ramsar Convention, elevating India's tally to 85 Ramsar sites.
records.exam_fact: India has the highest number of Ramsar sites in South Asia, and third highest globally (after the UK and Mexico).
records.why_important: Ramsar sites protect critical flood plains, migratory waterfowl flyways, and rural biodiversity.
records.related_static_topic: Ramsar Convention 1971 (signed in Ramsar, Iran) & Wildlife Protection Act 1972
records.related_banking_topic: Green Finance and Sustainable Development Goals (SDG 14 & 15)

mcqs.question: The Ramsar Convention on Wetlands was signed in 1971 in which country?
mcqs.explanation: The Convention on Wetlands of International Importance was adopted in the Iranian city of Ramsar on February 2, 1971 (celebrated annually as World Wetlands Day).

records.source: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (moef.gov.in)
